item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00226","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C01","C07","C04"],"selected_candidate_label":"C01","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C01 is a concrete and material drafting template. It uses nearly the same recital sequence and operative formula as the child for an adjacent Oahu military reservation: identification of Hawaii's ceded public lands and the prior reservation orders; a finding that the land is no longer needed for military purposes and should be restored to territorial use; restoration to the jurisdiction of the Territory of Hawaii; and numbered metes-and-bounds descriptions of the reservation and its rights-of-way. The child even describes a right-of-way to the Sugar Loaf Military Reservation addressed by C01, strengthening the inference that the two documents arose from the same closely related drafting project.
